title: Tests leave temp worktrees registered in the live repo
what: Find the tests that add worktrees of the live repository under $TMPDIR (git worktree list in the main checkout shows tmp.*/wt and tmp*/wt entries) and make them use a copy of the repo, or remove their worktree in cleanup even when the test fails; prune the 11 registrations left today.
why: 29 Oct 06:12: 11 detached temp worktrees registered in the main checkout, 8 of them 3-5 days old. Each shows up in relay doctor and git worktree list, and a test that registers worktrees in the live repo breaks the rule that tests never touch live state. Found by the leaked-processes design review. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: 29 Oct 06:12: `git -C ~/relay worktree list` lists 11 detached entries under the system temp folder ($TMPDIR).
pass_cases: After a full test run, git worktree list in the main checkout shows no entry under $TMPDIR.
where: tests/ (tests that run git worktree add against the live repository)
